item.title: OpenAI Launches ChatGPT Wallet to Let AI Agents Shop and Pay
item.description:
OpenAI launched a Wallet feature in ChatGPT that lets its agents, called dots, help users decide what to buy and complete the purchase on their behalf. The option is initially limited to U.S. ChatGPT Pro subscribers aged 18+ with a U.S.-issued Visa, Mastercard, or American Express. Users review items, totals, and the payment card before checkout and approve via Face ID or fingerprint, creating a transaction record. OpenAI also published a Commerce Partner Playbook to help retailers support agentic commerce.

原文标题：OpenAI 推出 ChatGPT 钱包 智能体可代用户下单支付

Why it matters：这是智能体从信息处理迈向真实交易闭环的关键一步，支付授权与安全机制的设计值得关注。

item.title: Nearly 70 Percent of US Agencies Use Generative AI as Unions Win Guardrails
item.description:
An Ernst & Young survey finds nearly 70 percent of US government agencies already deploy generative AI, while public-sector unions are rapidly securing protections. IFPTE Local 21 traded a strike vote for retraining instead of AI-driven layoffs, Pennsylvania's SEIU local won human oversight in a ChatGPT Enterprise pilot, and Ohio's transport union gained veto power over autonomous vehicles. Union leaders back AI safety systems that help workers but insist on mandatory human control over every workplace AI application.

原文标题：近七成美国机构已用生成式 AI，工会争取人类监督护栏

Why it matters：呈现生成式 AI 在公共部门的高渗透率与工会护栏谈判的最新实质进展，是观察 AI 落地治理的重要产业信号。

item.title: OpenAI Launches ChatGPT Wallet to Let Agents Shop for Users
item.description:
OpenAI launched ChatGPT Wallet with American Express, Mastercard and Visa, letting users enter card details once and then have the dot agent find products and complete purchases, with every transaction requiring security verification. Payment networks issue purpose-limited tokens per transaction so the agent never touches real card numbers. Initially limited to US Pro subscribers aged 18 and over with no transaction fees, OpenAI aims to position ChatGPT as a shopping destination.

原文标题：OpenAI 推出 ChatGPT Wallet 支持智能体代付购物

Why it matters：这是智能体从信息处理迈向真实交易闭环的关键一步，支付令牌机制也为 agent 安全授权提供了可复用范式。

item.title: Deepnote Launches Agent Initiative Benchmark for Proactive Agents
item.description:
Deepnote released the Agent Initiative Benchmark, which drops proactive agents into a simulated company Slack and scores whether they know when to intervene, what to say, and when to stay silent. GPT-6 Astra led at 8.97 out of 10, with GPT-6.1 Sol close behind at 8.65 at just $0.11 per task, versus $1.87 per task for third-placed Claude Fable 5.2. The open-source dataset and benchmark code give builders a reproducible basis for choosing models for proactive agent use cases.

原文标题：Deepnote 发布主动式智能体基准 12 款前沿模型同台竞技

Why it matters：首个聚焦智能体主动介入决策的公开基准，并附带开源数据集与代码，对智能体选型有直接参考价值。

item.title: Ex-OpenAI Researcher Finds Nvidia Blackwell Traces in Six Chinese Models
item.description:
Former OpenAI researcher Will DePue claims a forensic analysis uncovered technical fingerprints of Nvidia's export-controlled Blackwell GPUs inside models from six Chinese AI labs, including DeepSeek, Moonshot AI, MiniMax and Ant Group. He says the evidence shows access to the latest Nvidia hardware but does not by itself prove smuggling or a legal violation, since capacity could be rented at overseas data centers.

原文标题：前 OpenAI 研究员称六家中国模型暗藏 Blackwell 指纹

Why it matters：首次以技术取证方式指向中国实验室使用受管制的 Blackwell 算力，牵动出口管制与算力供应链核心议题。

item.title: Anthropic IPO Six Times Oversubscribed in Record $90 Billion Offering
item.description:
Anthropic's IPO is roughly six times oversubscribed, with the company aiming to raise up to $64.4 billion in the public offering plus $26 billion via a private placement at a target valuation of about $1.4 trillion, which would surpass SpaceX as the largest IPO ever. Annualized revenue rose to $81 billion by late October from $71 billion in September, and Nvidia is buying $10 billion of stock through the placement.

原文标题：Anthropic IPO 超额认购 6 倍 拟募资 900 亿美元

Why it matters：史上最大 IPO 叠加 1.4 万亿美元估值与 810 亿美元年化收入，是 AI 商业化进程的关键节点。

item.title: Meta's Muse Places Calls to Businesses but Many Hang Up on AI
item.description:
Meta's AI agent Muse now lets paying US subscribers delegate phone calls to cable companies, the DMV, and restaurants, with over 10 million users. The feature, tested in September, turns what Google Duplex demoed in 2018 into a standard capability of always-on AI agents. However, many businesses hang up as soon as they detect an AI caller, forcing Meta to adapt, while increasingly realistic synthetic voices make detection harder.

原文标题：Meta 的 Muse 可代用户致电商家，但许多企业一听是 AI 就挂断

Why it matters：这是常驻 AI 智能体从演示走向大规模商用代打电话的关键节点，同时暴露了商家端对 AI 来电的抵触这一真实落地阻力。

item.title: OpenAI Enters Cybersecurity Market with Two Daybreak Agent Products
item.description:
OpenAI launched two security products under its Daybreak brand: Red Team, which uses AI agents to map attack paths from source code and app context and to verify reported flaws and patches, and Defense Factory, which scans codebases and generates deployable fix pull requests with tests. Both run on the new GPT-6 Cyber model, marking OpenAI's formal entry into offensive and defensive cybersecurity.

原文标题：OpenAI 推出 Daybreak 双产品 进军网络安全市场

Why it matters：OpenAI 首次以专用模型加智能体产品组合进入网络安全攻防市场，是智能体落地与产业边界扩张的重要信号。

item.title: OpenAI Launches ChatGPT Wallet for Secure Agent Payments
item.description:
OpenAI has launched ChatGPT Wallet in partnership with American Express, Mastercard, and Visa, the first wallet that lets agents pay without accessing users' actual card details while requiring a security check for every purchase. Initially available to US ChatGPT Pro subscribers through dots, it preserves existing card rewards and dispute protections. OpenAI also released tools and guidance to help merchants accept legitimate agent-initiated payments within their existing systems.

Why it matters：这是智能体商业化的关键基础设施落地，首次给出智能体支付的卡组织级安全方案。

item.description:
Apple shares hit a record $360.18, lifting its market capitalization to $5.24 trillion, more than $1.3 trillion above Nvidia. Nvidia slipped below the $4 trillion mark after Jensen Huang resigned as president, CEO and board member, marking a sharp divergence between the two tech giants.

item.title: DeepMind Paper Shows Prompt Injection Remains Unsolved Against AI Agent Swarms
item.description:
A new Google DeepMind paper introduces Agentic Optimizer, a swarm of eight AI agent teams that share notes and build on each other's injection attempts, breaking the best-defended Gemini 4 Argon on 34% of 100 tool-use tasks. Open-weight models Kimi K3, GLM-5.3 and DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash resisted only 1% of tasks, showing that the near-failure of human red-teaming does not mean prompt injection is solved.

原文标题：DeepMind 新论文揭示提示注入仍未解决

Why it matters：该论文用多智能体自动攻击量化了提示注入的真实风险边界，对构建工具调用型 Agent 的开发者具有直接安全警示价值。

item.title: ElevenLabs Launches ElevenAI App for Team Meeting Notes and Dictation
item.description:
ElevenLabs unveiled ElevenAI, an experimental app combining meeting note-taking, dictation, and agent integration, at its 11/11 Summit. Still in preview with sign-up-only access, it is positioned as a team-level product rather than an individual productivity tool, directly contesting recent moves by Fireflies, Wispr Flow, and Granola.

item.title: Huawei Delays Xiaoyi AI Quick Bar Rollout to Mid-November
item.description:
Huawei's Xiaoyi AI Quick Bar, a Dock-resident assistant feature first teased at the HarmonyOS 7 launch, has slipped again from late October to mid-November 2026, starting with the Mate 90 series and Pura X View. A two-wave December rollout will extend it to Mate 80, Pura 90 and MatePad devices, limited to models with 12GB RAM or more.

item.description:

Medical professionals pushed back, calling the timeline ambitious or even misleading. The remarks come as Anthropic seeks investor backing at a trillion-dollar valuation.

item.title: SpaceXAI Cuts Grok Imagine Staff to Focus on AI Coding Tools
item.description:
SpaceXAI has laid off roughly 60 members of its Grok Imagine video and image generation team, retaining only a skeleton crew for basic operations. The cut continues the restructuring after the xAI-SpaceX merger and signals a strategic pivot toward AI coding tools and the Grok Bot agent, underscored by the $60 billion acquisition of Cursor.

item.title: DeepSeek Opens Full-Stack App API for One-to-One App Replication
item.description:
DeepSeek has opened its full-stack application API, letting developers enable parameters to obtain complete conversational capabilities including web search, deep-thinking search, file input and link reading, with tool calls and context assembly handled server-side. Voice and underlying capabilities (Search, Fetch, OCR, ASR, TTS) are also available as standalone endpoints, and an open-source frontend demo supports importing chat history, enabling one-to-one replication of the full DeepSeek App.

item.title: Lonewolf 0.3 Ships Standalone XMPP Server Written in Rust
item.description:
Lonewolf 0.3 is a self-hosted XMPP server written in Rust, emphasizing a single binary with embedded storage, low resource use and close adherence to core XMPP RFCs, with multi-domain chat, cross-server federation and multi-device support. It remains pre-1.0 with clustering not yet available, and most of its code, tests and docs are written by AI coding agents under maintainer review.

原文标题：Rust 编写的独立 XMPP 服务器 Lonewolf 发布 0.3 版

Why it matters：一个由 AI 智能体主力编写、Rust 实现的自托管 XMPP 服务器新版本，对关注开源通信基础设施与 AI 辅助开发实践者有参考价值。

item.title: South Korea Plans Radio Detectors to Curb AI Glasses Cheating
item.description:
South Korea's legislature is reviewing a roughly 6.57 billion KRW budget increase to buy 7,200 radio-signal detectors and deploy over 23,000 specialized proctors against AI-glasses cheating in national qualification exams. Because AI glasses closely resemble ordinary eyewear, this year's college entrance exam still relies mainly on visual inspection, while the education ministry has banned AI glasses from test sites and set penalties of up to three years of exam bans.

原文标题：韩国拟投 36 亿韩元采购设备防范 AI 眼镜作弊

Why it matters：这是 AI 硬件普及倒逼考试监管升级的典型产业落地信号，涉及具体预算、设备数量与执法数据。

item.title: llama.cpp Ships v1.0.0 Marking a Milestone for Local AI Inference
item.description:
llama.cpp has officially released v1.0.0, establishing a stable baseline 3.5 years after inception. Built on quantization, optimized backends and a portable C/C++ implementation, it runs multimodal LLMs from consumer hardware to enterprise servers, serving as a key foundation for local and private AI inference.

原文标题：llama.cpp 发布 v1.0.0 本地推理迎来里程碑

Why it matters：本地推理核心项目首次发布 1.0 稳定版，对开源生态与私有化部署具有节点意义。

item.title: Anthropic Launches Claude Duet Consumer Agent
item.description:
Anthropic has launched Claude Duet, a consumer-facing AI agent aimed at non-coders, positioned as more work-oriented than Meta Muse and OpenAI Dots but more accessible than Claude Cowork. Hands-on testing finds it genuinely helpful yet somewhat neurotic in judging when to interject, with tone and nuance still needing calibration.

原文标题：Anthropic 推出消费级智能体 Claude Duet

Why it matters：这是 Anthropic 消费级智能体产品的首份实测，直接反映 agent 从编码走向大众场景的落地现状与短板。

item.title: Oklo's Groves-1 Test Reactor Cleared for Full Operations
item.description:
The US Department of Energy has lifted the final operations hold point on Oklo's Groves-1 test reactor near Lockhart, Texas, clearing it to enter research, testing and training operations. The reactor reached first criticality in August, less than a year after groundbreaking, and is one of 11 advanced reactor projects selected for the DOE Nuclear Reactor Pilot Program. Operating experience will feed directly into Oklo's planned Groves-2 Forge isotope facility and its fast fission reactor work.

原文标题：Oklo 试验反应堆获准全面运行

Why it matters：先进核裂变试验堆获准全面运行，为 AI 数据中心供电的核能路线再添实质进展。

Eli Lilly's CEO publicly pushed back on Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei's prediction that cancer, Alzheimer's, heart disease and mental illness will be cured within a decade, calling the timeline medically unrealistic. The dispute unfolded around Anthropic's IPO launch, with experts widely criticizing the overpromise as Theranos-style hype.

item.title: TSMC Launches $500 Million Venture Fund to Back Chip Startups
item.description:
TSMC plans to set up a $500 million venture fund aimed at backing chip startups that could become the next Nvidia or Broadcom, formalizing its investment mechanism for the first time. The fund will extend beyond direct customers to suppliers and upstream partners, while TSMC has also committed up to $500 million each to Anthropic and OpenAI.

item.title: South Korean AI Data Center Plans Lag Far Behind Gigawatt Targets
item.description:
South Korean carriers and cloud providers including KT, SK Telecom and Naver have announced gigawatt-scale AI data center ambitions, yet their operating capacity remains in the tens to hundreds of megawatts, with KT and SK Telecom at only 13-15% of their 1GW targets. Meanwhile CoreWeave already runs 1.7GW with another 4.6GW contracted, leaving Korean players behind in both customer acquisition and buildout pace.

item.title: Dalian University of Technology Unveils 20 kg Hydrogen-Powered Unmanned Helicopter
item.description:
A team at Dalian University of Technology's School of Chemical Engineering has developed China's first 20 kg-class hydrogen-powered unmanned helicopter, offering both pure hydrogen fuel cell and hydrogen-lithium hybrid configurations. The 12L fuel-cell variant reaches a 3-hour endurance, several times the roughly 30 minutes of conventional lithium-battery drones, and has completed a sea trial cruise in Force 6 winds.

原文标题：大连理工研制 20 公斤级氢能无人直升机 续航 3 小时

Why it matters：氢能动力无人机实现数倍续航提升并完成海上大风实测，是具身智能与新能源航空交叉落地的具体工程案例。

item.title: 黄仁勋承认英伟达面临晶圆与内存供应过剩危机
item.description:

Why it matters：英伟达高层内幕首次证实 AI 算力需求被夸大与供应链过剩风险，对判断算力周期具有关键参考价值。
